info.name: CreatorConnect - API Gateway (Full Flow)
info.description:
Complete CreatorConnect flow through the API Gateway.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080 (API Gateway — single entry point). All paths below are the SAME as the service paths; the gateway routes them to the right service via Eureka.

Setup:
1. Run "Register User" then "Login" to obtain a JWT.
2. Postman script on Login auto-saves {{jwtToken}} and {{userId}} (userId is TOP-LEVEL in data, NOT nested under user).
3. Run Create Profile → Get My Profile → Update Profile → Delete Profile.
4. Security requests are pre-built: missing/invalid/expired token (401) and ownership (403).

Expected status codes are listed in each request description.

Also useful:
- GET /actuator/gateway/routes — lists the 5 configured gateway routes (auth, profile, project, hiring, ai).

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's own profile.

Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}

Expected: 200 OK with the profile in data.

Errors: 401 missing/invalid JWT · 404 no profile yet.

Returns any user's profile by userId (UUID). Any authenticated user may view any profile.

Expected: 200 OK.

Errors: 400 invalid UUID · 401 · 404 not found.

Partially updates the profile owned by userId (PUT-as-PATCH: omitted fields unchanged).

Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}} · Content-Type: application/json
Body: any subset of { firstName, lastName, headline, bio, profileImageUrl, location, website, linkedin, github, skills, experience, availableForHire }

Expected: 200 OK with the updated profile.

Errors: 400 · 401 · 403 not the owner · 404 profile not found.

Deletes the profile owned by userId.

Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}

Expected: 200 OK with empty data.

Errors: 400 · 401 · 403 not the owner · 404 profile not found.

A genuinely expired token: exp = 1700000001 (Nov 2023) with a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature computed with the shared dev secret and the correct issuer.

Expected: 401 Unauthorized (JwtService rejects expired tokens, even though the signature is valid).

A SECOND user (token in {{otherJwtToken}}) tries to update the profile of {{userId}}.

Setup: register+login a second account and set {{otherJwtToken}} to its accessToken.

Expected: 403 Forbidden — ownership validation rejects non-owners.
